edit.title: Edit the trip
edit.unpublished: You have changes that aren’t published yet. The other tabs already show them.
edit.published: Published. Phones get the new trip within a few minutes, the next time they’re online.
edit.publishedNoCopy: Published, but the readable copy in the private repository wasn’t updated: {error}
edit.pending: Just published: GitHub needs a few minutes to update the site. This device already uses the new trip.
edit.discardConfirm: Tap again to discard all changes
edit.moreNote: Lists, phrases, money, help and settings: edit them as JSON. The app checks everything before it publishes.
edit.day.title: Title of the day
edit.event.title: What
edit.place.name: Name
edit.ticket.title: Ticket
edit.json.note: Edit carefully: Apply changes only this device. Publish checks everything first.
edit.json.notObject: This must be a JSON object: { … }
edit.err.imageType: Use a PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF or SVG image.
edit.err.dateOrder: {value} must come after the day before.
edit.err.icon: “{value}” is not one of the app’s icons.
edit.err.listId: the list id “{value}” is used twice.
edit.err.demoDay.one: is {value}, but the trip has {count} day. Use a day number that exists, or null for a real trip.
edit.err.demoDay.other: is {value}, but the trip has {count} days. Use a day number that exists, or null for a real trip.
edit.err.noToken: This trip has no GitHub token yet. On your computer, run: trip admin
edit.err.offline: No internet. Your changes are kept on this device: publish when you’re online.
edit.err.conflict: The trip was changed elsewhere since this app opened it (trip build, or another device). Close and reopen the app, then make your changes again. If it was published just now, wait a few minutes first.
edit.err.token: GitHub refused the token: it has expired or was deleted. Make a new one, then run: trip admin
edit.err.access: The token can’t write to {repo}. Check its repositories and its Contents permission.
edit.err.race: {repo} changed at the same moment. Try again.
edit.err.github: GitHub answered with error {status} for {repo}. Try again later.
edit.err.network: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check the internet connection and try again.
